articles.title: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
articles.description: The trade deal is unlikely lower food prices for shoppers, but should boost the economy more than other post-Brexit agreements.
articles.summary: The prime minister made a lot of the UK's new deal with the EU cutting costs for business and consumers during tough times.
key_points: In another world, Andy Burnham would have loved for the nation's supermarkets to clearly announce that they could cut food prices as a result of this latest agreement on food exports.
And while grocers have very much welcomed Friday's announcement, they have notably not committed to price cuts as a direct result of this move.
The managing director of M&S, Alex Freudmann, called the deal a "major step forward", saying it would remove bureaucracy.

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall a day after blockbuster opening
articles.description: Other tech companies have also taken a hit as share markets broadly slump.
articles.summary: Anthropic's share price has dropped back towards its initial public offering (IPO) price a day after its soaring market debut, as the broader tech sell off continues.
key_points: The artificial intelligence (AI) company's introduction to the Nasdaq stock exchange on Thursday was a crucial test for the industry and was largely seen as a success, with trading starting at $111.50.
However, Anthropic's shares fell on Friday, dropping more than 10% to about $87.30, close to its IPO price of $83, and the broader stock market declines seen on Thursday continued.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index fell 2.8% in morning trade, the S&P 500 was down 1.2% while the Dow Jones Industrial Average remained largely flat.

articles.title: Airbnb's divisive new house rules come into force
articles.description: New rules on what Airbnb hosts can reasonably ask guests to do could mean fewer chores but higher costs for customers.
articles.summary: New rules on what Airbnb hosts can reasonably ask guests to do have come into force.
key_points: Hosts should now not normally ask guests to wash up, for example, but can appeal to Airbnb if they have a compelling reason.
Some guests have found lists of house rules laborious to complete, with one telling the BBC "it was not relaxing at all".
But some hosts have said that the costs of paying for extra cleaning may have to be passed on to customers.
